themes.name: Agentic AI in research

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to help developers write, review, and debug code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI applications used for research purposes, including search, analysis, and data gathering.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights the application of AI in the design process, from ideation to UX/UI refinement and research integration.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated user representations for testing, research, or simulation.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Covers AI's role in evaluating and testing user interfaces and experiences for ease of use and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze customer data and generate actionable insights for product and business development.

themes.description: Details AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as earnings calls or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI testing automation
